The '''ploughman's lunch''' is traditional British pub fare, a hearty cold meal featuring bread, cheese and pickle. Its history is not actually that old, and doesn't really date back to actual ploughmen—see [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ploughman%27s_lunch Wikipedia on Ploughman's lunch].

== Ingredients ==
* 1 big chunk of good English [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]] (e.g. Cheshire, Stilton, Lancashire), or a selection of 2–3 types of cheese if available
* 1 big doorstop of granary bread
* [[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]]
* [[Cookbook:Pickle|Pickle]] (e.g. Branston pickle, or a good chunky local pickle)
* [[Cookbook:Lettuce|Lettuce]] leaves
* ½ [[Cookbook:Apple|apple]] (optional)
* Pickled [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]] (optional)
* Cocktail pork pie (optional)
* Sausage rolls (optional)

== Procedure ==
